title: SV-12539 - Inventory Value link, PDF and CSV work as before the staging deploy
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the organization has two or more locations, so one location can be ticked in Inventory Value's Location filter.
  • Make sure that before the feature was deployed on staging, you saved Inventory Value's PDF and CSV for an as-of date before the feature was deployed on staging with one location ticked, and copied a link to Inventory Value with that filter.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • After the feature is deployed on staging, open Reports (top menu; its left menu lists the A/R reports under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and the A/P reports under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Inventory Value link saved before the feature was deployed on staging.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Open the PDF and compare it with the saved PDF.
  4. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  5. Open the CSV and compare it with the saved CSV.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Inventory Value opens with the same filter ticked as before.

Step 2:

  • The PDF downloads.

Step 3:

  • The same rows, amounts and layout as the saved PDF.

Step 4:

  • The CSV downloads.

Step 5:

  • The same rows, amounts and layout as the saved CSV.

Why: the six aging reports reuse the filter chips, totals row and export of Inventory Value, Sales By Customer and Work In Progress, so a change made for the aging reports could reach those three.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

From: Developer verify task SV-11597 "A/R & A/P aging — verify Phase 1: shared report kit" (updated 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Jira SV-11597, Check: “Inventory Value, Sales By Customer and Work In Progress: filters, links shared from the address bar, and CSV/PDF exports behave exactly as before.”

Last checked against build v26.45.2-6a8b89c (QA site sv11315) on 11/10/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html); page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). The design draws no picture of this behaviour (all 7 boards and 45 figures checked); the case follows the PRD.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs records and screenshots captured before the release is installed on the test site

Preconditions

  • On staging the saved files and links are in files and links. With only Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 ticked, the PDF already failed before the feature was deployed on staging ("This report is too large to export. Narrow the date range or filters, then try again."), so compare the files saved with only DVI Test ticked, and open the link saved with it. Set the as-of date to 12 Nov 2026. The production snapshot of 10 Nov 2026 (production before the release) is kept for the short check on production after the release.
